paragraphs: A modern personal portfolio showcasing my work, skills, experience, and selected projects as a developer.
This is my personal developer portfolio — a place where I showcase my projects, technical skills, experience, certificates, and the technologies I work with.

The portfolio is designed to be more than a traditional single-page website. It uses a component-based React architecture and separate routes for different sections of the portfolio, creating a cleaner and more interactive browsing experience.
features: A payment and escrow-oriented platform designed to improve trust between buyers and sellers in online marketplaces and Telegram stores.
The concept is based on holding a payment until the buyer receives the product, helping reduce the risk of fraudulent transactions.
Focus: FinTech · Payments · Escrow · Telegram ecosystem
A map-based application focused on measuring and working with geographic boundaries and distances.
The project combines interactive maps with measurement tools and a modern React interface.
